scripts.copy-bootstrap-icons: mkdir -p public/assets/css/vendor/fonts && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/* public/assets/css/vendor/fonts/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.css public/assets/css/vendor/
scripts.copy-leaflet: mkdir -p public/assets/js/vendor public/assets/css/vendor/images && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js public/assets/js/vendor/ && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.css public/assets/css/vendor/ && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/images/* public/assets/css/vendor/images/
